name: Germanic Night Raiders

abilities.name: Precision Shot
abilities.text: Improved missile weapon damage for an extended period. These values are further modified by the unit itself.

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

attributes.name: Campaign Stealth
attributes.text: This unit can move around the campaign map without being seen.

attributes.name: Resistant to Fatigue
attributes.text: Fatigue has less of an effect on this unit.

attributes.name: Guerrilla Deployment
attributes.text: This unit can deploy outside of the deployment zone.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Ignore Terrain
attributes.text: Speed penalties caused by the terrain are ignored by this unit.

attributes.name: Fire Whilst Moving
attributes.text: This unit can fire when mounted and moving.

attributes.name: Parthian Shot
attributes.text: This unit can fire all around and not just in-front of itself.

attributes.name: Raider
attributes.text: This unit may set buildings on fire, cause more fire damage with torches and capture faster than other units.

attributes.name: Snipe
attributes.text: This unit remains hidden while firing.

short: Only the bravest dare mount a raid under cover of darkness.
history: The Germanic Harii tribe were a warrior cult, shrouded in mystery. Their warriors were a terrifying prospect if met on the battlefield. Their bodies, shields and weapons were painted black for maximum shock value. The Roman historian, Tacitus, said this of the Harii: “…quite apart from their strength, which exceeds that of the other tribes I have just listed, they pander to their innate savagery by skill and timing: with black shields and painted bodies, they choose dark nights to fight, and by means of terror and shadow of a ghostly army they caused panic, since no enemy could bear a sight so unexpected and hellish; in every battle the eyes are the first to be conquered”.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
